tools.name: search_backgrounds
tools.description: Search the AniBG library of free anime backgrounds (scenery without characters). Use it first whenever someone wants an anime background, wallpaper or scene for a visual novel, stream, video call or desktop. Words for a place or a time inside q act as filters, in English, Japanese or Chinese ("night

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: One scene by its id (from search_backgrounds): every time of day it comes in with permanent links (1920 JPG, 1280 and 640 WebP), alt text, the light and colours of each, the objects in it, its page and the license. Use it when the user wants another time of day of a scene or details about it. Exampl

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Everything the library can be filtered by: the places with how many scenes each has and a cover picture, the times of day, tags, uses and styles. Use it to see what exists before searching or to offer the user a choice. Optional lang (ja, zh) for the names. Example: {}

tools.name: download_image
tools.description: Fetch one picture so you can see it: returns the image itself, plus its permanent links and alt text. Use it only when you need to look (to check a picture suits the user, or to describe it); to hand a picture over, give the user the url from search_backgrounds instead. size 1280 (WebP, usually 100

tools.name: studio_link
tools.description: A link for the user to make a background the library does not have, in AniBG Studio. The user opens the link, and making a picture costs them credits (or one of two free previews a day). Use it when this connection has no API key (generate_background paints directly when it has one). tools.name: generate_background
tools.description: Paint a new anime background (scenery without characters) with the user's AniBG credits, when search_backgrounds has nothing that fits and the user wants it made. Needs the user's AniBG API key on this connection (header Authorization: Bearer anibg_…); without one the tool says where the user gets i

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: A picture started with generate_background, by its id: its status, and when done the link to give the user. Needs the same API key. Waits up to wait seconds for it to finish. Example: {"id": "3f9a2c…"}

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_background" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
